title: Brazilian Chicken Wrap
description: A flavorful and spicy wrap filled with grilled chicken and sautéed vegetables, inspired by Brazilian cuisine.
instructions: Season chicken with salt, pepper, and your favorite spices.
Grill chicken for 5-6 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, heat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add sliced red bell pepper and red onion; cook for 3-4 minutes, or until tender.
Add sliced jalapeño pepper and cook for an additional minute.
Warm the tortilla by wrapping it in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the wrap by spreading salsa on the tortilla, followed by grilled chicken, sautéed vegetables, and shredded cheese (if using).
